name: Screen Wake Lock
plain: Keeps the screen on while the page is visible.
meaning: Stops the display from dimming or locking, which can drain battery and expose the screen. Browsers drop it when the page is hidden or battery is low, so it cannot hold the screen on in the background.

access.prompt_ui: No prompt in most browsers; Chrome keeps a policy gate; the permission state granted, denied or prompt follows policy and battery.
access.persistence: Held only while the document is visible
access.revocation: Page hidden, low battery or power saver, sentinel.release()
steps: Lock releases on hide, low battery or release()

limits.headline: Can keep your screen on while the page is showing, but not in the background
limits.user_action: You open a recipe, video or presentation and the page asks to stay awake
can: Stop the screen from dimming or locking while the page is visible
Keep a recipe or slide show on screen
Work in all major browsers with no pop up in most
cannot: Keep the screen on once you switch tabs or minimize the page
Hold the screen on when battery is low
Keep the computer awake when the screen is off
Override browser rules that release it when the page is hidden
limits.reach_label: Only while the page is visible

story.what_it_is: A page can keep your screen from dimming or locking while you use it.

marketing.name: Screen Wake Lock API
marketing.pitch: Stops the screen from turning off while you read, cook, present or watch, with no user setting changes.

story.for_you: You do not see a prompt. While you watch a video or follow a recipe, your screen stays on. It lets go when you leave the page. It can use more battery.
story.for_makers: Makers use it for reading, video, maps, recipes and live scoreboards, where a dimmed screen breaks the experience. It only works while the tab is visible. The browser can release it when battery is low.

use_cases.example: A video site keeps the screen on while you watch, so the screen does not dim mid movie.
A browser game with long thoughtful turns, or a cloud game stream, keeps the display awake while you play with a gamepad.
A recipe site keeps the screen on while you cook with messy hands.
A web map app keeps the display on while you navigate a walk.
A live scoreboard or stream stays visible during a match.
A slide viewer keeps the screen on while you present.
A workout timer site keeps the screen on while you exercise.
A web ticket page keeps the QR code bright for a scanner at the gate.
